read2（）;“九天圣莲华？”
感受着脑中突然多出的这朵九瓣莲花，林无缺先是一愣，接着便目光闪烁，似是想到了许多！
刚刚的那场震撼人心的大对决，让林无缺大开眼界，虽然画面已经结束，但那抹震撼依旧盘桓在他的心底，无法忘怀！
那三个追击福伯和他的恐怖人物个个简直都是强的让人窒息，尤其是三人所打出的大杀术！
林无缺清楚，刚刚他跨越时空所看到的那一幕是处在宇宙当中，那样冰冷、枯寂地方，不要说是动手，普通修士简直连存活下去的资格都没有。
但三人却依然可以打出如此的杀术，只能说这三人的修为已经强大到了一定境界，足以使他们横渡宇宙，摘星拿月！
煌煌犹如灭世的三大杀术让林无缺久久无法忘怀，但即便如此，福伯依旧以一己之力将这三大杀术完美的拦截下来，而且己身没有受伤。
福伯的修为，或许比之那三人还要强上一些。
“皇甫荒……这便是福伯真正的名字么？”
画面中金甲金身之人叫出的这个名字，让林无缺知道，也许这才是福伯的本名。
深深呼出了一口气，林无缺站起身来盘坐到床榻之上，紧紧闭上了双眼，陷入了沉思。
“空，刚刚的那一幕你有没有看到？”
闭上眼的林无缺在心中发问。
“没有，当那条形似血龙的生物从你的魄月当中游弋出来时，我便感觉到一股极端恐怖的力量蕴含其中。等我想要提醒你的时候，发现已经来不及，你的神魂被这股恐怖的力量包裹，接着便陷入了奇异的状态。不过随后我发现这股力量似乎并没有恶意，所以便由它去了。”
对于方才发生的一切，空也是极为的意外，血龙玉当中所蕴藏的力量之强大，完全超过空的预计，空不知道那股恐怖力量包裹林无缺之后，到底发生了什么，只是刚刚在林无缺神魂之中突然出现的一朵九瓣莲花，让空明白，林无缺有所收获。
得到来自空的回答，林无缺也不再犹豫，当下便把刚刚他的所见所感悉数一字不落的告诉了空。
对于空，林无缺无需隐瞒。
林无缺静静说完之后，整个房间安静了起来，很显然，林无缺说的话，让空也一时陷入了沉默。
良久，空的声音再度响起。

“以一枚血龙玉为介，将十几年发生的事以大法力留在其中，使这段记忆保留至今，能够让你看到。如此看来，你的福伯，比我想象中的还要强啊！”
虽然不曾亲眼看到那一幕，但通过林无缺的形容，空明白了那一幕所代表的意义。
双眼微眯，林无缺想到了那三个追击福伯和年幼自己的恐怖大能说道：“听那金甲金身之人的口气，似乎已经追击福伯三年，那么按那时的时间算，三年前的话，当时的我还只是一个刚刚出生的婴儿。”
林无缺的眼中闪过莫名的亮光：“空，换句话说，我在一出生便被福伯带走，继而便遭到了那三个恐怖大能的追杀，这里面，或许牵扯到了我的亲生父母……”
语气中含着一抹忧伤，似是想起了那从未有过任何记忆的父母。
“不过，你的福伯安危倒是无须担心，毕竟如你所说，画面中的时间是十多年前，那是的你还未来到慕容家，这说明，你的福伯带着你逃过了当时那三人的追杀。”
轻轻点头，这一点林无缺已经想明白，不过随即他的眉头一皱：“空，本来我对福伯在将我寄养慕容家后独自离开还有些疑虑，如今看来，或许与这三个恐怖大能有关。”
血龙玉当中的所见所感，让林无缺之前的猜测有了丝丝的认证，福伯的离开，也许和那三个恐怖大能脱不了关系。
右手婆娑着血龙玉，触手依旧温润，只是林无缺知道，血龙玉当中的造化已经没有了，此时的血龙玉已经变回了一枚普通的玉佩。
“空，我想福伯在血龙玉当中留下这段画面并让我看见，除了是在告诉我某些信息外，更多的便要传授我这神通……九天圣莲华吧。”
九九归一，步步生莲！
九瓣白莲，虚空绽放，福伯使出这九天圣莲华，便将那三人的大杀术悉数拦下，或许福伯本身修为高深莫测，但也证明这九天圣莲华的神奇和强大！
神魂空间的九瓣莲花虽然只是个光影，但随着林无缺调动自己的神魂去接近它之后，一股玄奥之极的意念便随之出现在林无缺的脑海中，半个时辰之后，林无缺再度睁开了眼睛，眼中流露出一抹喜意和藏不住的惊叹震撼！
“九天圣莲华……取莲花九瓣之意，一瓣莲花一伟力，九瓣齐绽，璀璨虚空，蕴含无上玄妙，攻防一体，既是攻杀大术，又是防护宝术。凭此一神通，本身修为到的话，便可先天立于不败之地……真是了不起的绝学啊！”
林无缺满是惊叹的声音响起，福伯留给他的这九天圣莲华威能无法想象，根本超出了绝学的范畴。
“无缺，用绝学来形容这九天圣莲华，简直是在侮辱它，如果我所料不差，九天圣莲华，乃是一种神通！”
“神通？”
空的话让林无缺一愣，但却没有反驳，因为对于这些修炼的常识，他是真的不太清楚，在他的印象中，上品绝学便是他所接触过的最高等级了，但这九天圣莲华的威力，根本不是绝学所能发挥出来的。
“你现在身怀的地煞虎贲拳，只是中品绝学，慕容家的天罡游龙手，也只是上品绝学，但这世间何其大？修士所练就的战斗绝学远超于此！在上品绝学之上，还有天、地、玄、黄四大等级的战斗绝学，那黄级绝学，哪怕只是下品，其威力也是上品绝学的十倍以上！更不用说更高的玄级了，至于地级乃至天级，其威力更是可怕无比，移山倒海也不在话下，只有那些超级势力才会拥有这两个等级的战斗绝学。而这九天圣莲华却是神通，何谓神通？神之手段，便是神通，所以这神通更是超越了天级，用战斗绝学已经无法形容！你的福伯，留给了你一式神通，当真是如同留下了一个造化。他对你，寄望甚深！”
空带着莫名口吻说完了这些话，让林无缺心中震撼，也是明白了这神通九天圣莲华的珍贵和强大！更是明白了福伯对他的期望！

“福伯……你放心，我一定不会辜负你的期望……”
“嗡”

read2(); "Nine Heavens Holy Lotus?"
Feeling the sudden appearance of the nine-petal lotus in his mind, Lin Wuque was stunned for a moment, and then his eyes flickered, as if he had thought of a lot!
The shocking duel just now was an eye-opener for Lin Wuque. Although the scene had ended, the shock still lingered in his heart and he could not forget it!
The three terrifying figures who were chasing Fu Bo and him were all so powerful that it was suffocating, especially the killing skills unleashed by the three of them!
Lin Wuque knew clearly that the scene he just saw across time and space was in the universe, in such a cold and dead place. Let alone taking action, ordinary monks simply had no qualifications to survive.
But the three of them can still perform such killing techniques. It can only be said that the cultivation of these three people has reached a certain level, which is enough for them to travel across the universe and reach the stars and the moon!
Lin Wuque could not forget Huanghuang's world-destroying three killing techniques for a long time, but even so, Fu Bo still perfectly intercepted these three killing techniques on his own without being injured.
Uncle Fu's cultivation may be stronger than those three people.
"Huangfu Huang...is this Uncle Fu's real name?"
The name called by the man in golden armor and body in the picture made Lin Wuque know that maybe this was Fu Bo's real name.
After taking a deep breath, Lin Wuque stood up and sat cross-legged on the bed, closed his eyes tightly and fell into deep thought.
"Sora, did you see the scene just now?"
Lin Wuque, who closed his eyes, asked in his mind.
"No, when the blood dragon-like creature swam out of your soul moon, I felt an extremely terrifying power contained in it. When I wanted to remind you, I found it was too late. Your soul was wrapped in this terrifying power, and then you fell into a strange state. But then I found that this power did not seem to have any malicious intent, so I let it go."
Kong was also extremely surprised by what had just happened. The power contained in the Blood Dragon Jade was completely beyond Kong's expectation. Kong didn't know what happened after that terrifying power enveloped Lin Wuque. It was just that a nine-petal lotus suddenly appeared in Lin Wuque's soul, letting Kong understand that Lin Wuque had gained something.
After receiving the answer from Kong, Lin Wuque no longer hesitated and immediately told Kong everything he had seen and felt word for word.
Lin Wuque didn't need to hide anything about Kong.
After Lin Wuque finished speaking quietly, the whole room became quiet. Obviously, what Lin Wuque said made Kongya fall into silence for a moment.
After a long time, Sora's voice sounded again.
"Using a blood dragon jade as a medium, I used great magic power to retain the events that happened over ten years ago, so that this memory can be preserved to this day so that you can see it. From this, it seems that your Uncle Fu is stronger than I imagined!"
Although he had never seen that scene with his own eyes, through Lin Wuque's description, Kong understood the meaning of that scene.
Narrowing his eyes slightly, Lin Wuque thought of the three terrifying powers who were chasing Uncle Fu and his young self and said: "From the tone of the man with golden armor and golden body, it seems that he has been chasing Uncle Fu for three years. So based on that time, three years ago, I was just a newborn baby at that time."
An inexplicable light flashed in Lin Wuque's eyes: "Kong, in other words, I was taken away by Uncle Fu as soon as I was born, and then I was hunted down by those three terrifying powers. This may involve my biological parents..."
There was a hint of sadness in his tone, as if he was thinking of his parents who had never had any memories.
"However, there is no need to worry about your Uncle Fu's safety. After all, as you said, the time in the picture was more than ten years ago, and you had not yet arrived at Murong's house. This means that your Uncle Fu took you to escape the pursuit of those three people at that time."
Lin Wuque nodded slightly, this pointHe had figured it out, but then he frowned: "Kong, originally I had some doubts about Uncle Fu leaving me alone after fostering me in the Murong family. Now it seems that it may have something to do with these three terrifying powers."
What he saw and felt in the Blood Dragon Jade confirmed Lin Wuque's previous speculation. Uncle Fu's departure may have something to do with those three terrifying powers.
The blood dragon jade was whirling in his right hand, and the tentacles were still warm and moist, but Lin Wuque knew that the good fortune in the blood dragon jade was gone, and the blood dragon jade had turned back into an ordinary jade pendant.
"Song, I think Uncle Fu left this scene in the Blood Dragon Jade and let me see it. In addition to telling me some information, he also wanted to teach me this magical power... the Nine Heavens Holy Lotus Flower."
Jiujiu returns to one, and lotuses grow every step of the way!
The nine-petaled white lotus bloomed in the void. Uncle Fu used this Nine-Heaven Holy Lotus and stopped all three people's killing techniques. Perhaps Fu Bo's own cultivation is unfathomable, but it also proves the magic and power of this Nine-Heaven Holy Lotus!
Although the nine-petal lotus in the soul space was just a light and shadow, as Lin Wuque mobilized his soul to get close to it, an extremely mysterious idea appeared in Lin Wuque's mind. Half an hour later, Lin Wuque opened his eyes again, with a touch of joy and uncontrollable shock in his eyes!
"The Holy Lotus of the Nine Heavens... takes the meaning of the nine petals of the lotus. One lotus petal has great power. The nine petals bloom together, shining in the void, containing the supreme mystery. It is an integrated attack and defense technique. It is both a great attack and a defensive technique. With this magical power, if you have reached the level of cultivation, you can be innately invincible... What an amazing secret!"
Lin Wuque's voice was full of amazement. The power of the Nine Heavens Holy Lotus that Uncle Fu left to him was unimaginable and beyond the scope of his unique skills.
"Wu Que, using the unique skill to describe this Nine Heavens Saint Lotus is simply insulting it. If what I expected is correct, the Nine Heavens Saint Lotus is a kind of magical power!"
"Supernatural powers?"
Lin Wuque was stunned by Kong's words, but he did not refute, because he really didn't know much about these common sense of cultivation. In his impression, the top-grade secret skill was the highest level he had ever come into contact with, but the power of the Nine Heavens Saint Lotus was beyond what the secret skill could bring out.
"The Earthly Evil Tiger Ben Fist you are carrying now is only a middle-grade secret skill, and the Murong family's Tiangang Wandering Dragon Shou is only a high-grade secret skill, but how big is this world? The combat secret skills practiced by monks are far beyond this! Among the top-grade secret skills, Above, there are four levels of combat secrets: Heaven, Earth, Xuan, and Huang. The yellow-level secrets, even if they are only low-grade, are more than ten times as powerful as the top-grade secrets, not to mention the higher Xuan-level ones. As for the earth-level and even heaven-level secrets! Level, its power is so terrifying that it can move mountains and seas. Only those superpowers have these two levels of magical power. What is magical power? Divine power, so this magical power is beyond the level of heaven, and it is indescribable with combat skills! Your uncle has left you a magical power. He has great hopes for you! "
Kong finished these words with an inexplicable tone, which shocked Lin Wuque's heart, and he also understood the preciousness and power of this magical Nine Heavens Holy Lotus! He even understood what Fu Bo expected of him!
